paragraphs: R' Yonah, father of R' Yishmael.
Mentioned at the beginning of Chelek in the Jerusalem Talmud, but Hyman says there is a scribal error there; see the entry R' Yishmael.[^1][^2]

notes.text: ריש חלק retains beginning of Chelek without adding an independently verified chapter 10 mapping or specific passage.

ט״ס is conventionally scribal error; יש שם means there is there, not a separate reading the-name. Hyman does not specify the error or its correction. The complete father relation and pointer remain, with all three title occurrences R'.
